evidence: Dissociative reaction, including ligand exchange, of TMAl on SAMs with a CH3 terminal group has been found to be nearly quenched because of a small thermodynamic driving force and a large kinetic barrier. This relative inertness of TMAl on CH3–SAMs is potentially an advantage for growing an AlOx barrier layer, i.e. the SAMs will not be impacted by TMAl. Furthermore, water used as an oxygen source is not reactive with alkane chains, but is expected to form droplets on the hydrophobic surface of the densely ordered SAMs. A reaction of these droplets with pyrophoric TMAl should form AlOx nuclei.
